description: This source file defines the internal class TimerRegistry within the Orleans.Runtime.Timers namespace. It implements the ITimerRegistry interface and provides methods to register timers for grains, managing timer creation and callback invocation using underlying timer classes like GrainTimer and InterleavingGrainTimer.

classes.name: TimerRegistry
classes.description: Implements timer registration functionality for Orleans grains, using injected dependencies such as logger, time provider, message factory, and silo details.

methods.name: RegisterTimer
methods.description: Registers a timer for a grain with specified callback, state, due time, and period. Returns an IDisposable representing the timer.

methods.name: RegisterGrainTimer
methods.description: Registers a grain timer with specific options including due time, period, interleaving, and keep-alive settings.
